notes.title: Takeo Arc Fix and small bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hi Players,

We have had feedback that the Takeo ending is too hard to get. We've made some tweaks to the game as well as some cosmetic and spelling fixes. We hope you have loved the sequel.

We would also be grateful if you can support some of our future projects. So be awesome and vote us up!!!!

Keep being Awesome!

SDP Team
